About Sanfreight

Invest, Structure, Unlock Value.
A Trusted Partner in Global Logistics & Supply Chain Solutions

SanFreight Logistics is a global partner providing integrated freight forwarding and supply chain solutions.

With expertise in ocean and air freight, customs, warehousing, and project logistics, we ensure cargo moves with precision and efficiency. Leveraging industry experience and global partnerships, our team creates tailored strategies to simplify complex supply chains while maintaining high reliability.

Every solution is designed for unique client needs, providing visibility and value from routine to specialized shipments.

We remain committed to delivering smart, sustainable logistics that support business growth worldwide.

Our services

Comprehensive logistics solutions for every need

01

Ocean Freight That Connects Global Trade.

Reliable ocean freight solutions built to move your cargo seamlessly across international markets. With a strong global carrier network and decades of logistics expertise, we ensure dependable shipping performance from origin to destination.

  • Reliable FCL and LCL services across major global trade routes, supported by trusted partnerships with leading international ocean carriers.
  • Flexible shipping solutions tailored to your cargo, delivery schedules, and business objectives, ensuring efficiency without compromising reliability.
  • Complete shipment coordination including documentation, customs support, cargo tracking, and seamless delivery from origin to final destination.
02

Air Freight When Time Matters Most.

Our air freight solutions are designed for businesses that demand speed, precision, and reliability. Backed by a global airline network and experienced logistics professionals, we ensure your shipments reach their destination safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

  • Fast and dependable air freight services connecting major global destinations with optimized transit times and reliable carrier partnerships.
  • Specialized handling for urgent, fragile, high-value, and temperature-controlled shipments, ensuring maximum safety and regulatory compliance.
  • End-to-end shipment coordination with documentation support, customs clearance, real-time cargo tracking, and proactive operational updates.
03

Customs Clearance Without Delays.

Our customs clearance solutions are designed to simplify international trade while ensuring full regulatory compliance and efficient cargo movement.

  • Experienced customs professionals ensuring compliance with evolving international trade regulations and customs requirements.
  • Accurate documentation, duty processing, and import-export clearance to facilitate faster cargo movement across global markets.
  • Proactive customs coordination that minimizes delays, reduces compliance risks, and keeps your supply chain operating without disruption.
04

Integrated Transportation & Warehousing.

Our integrated transportation and warehousing solutions are designed to keep your supply chain efficient, connected, and responsive.

  • Secure warehousing solutions designed to optimize inventory management, storage efficiency, and order fulfillment.
  • Reliable transportation services across diverse cargo categories, ensuring safe, timely, and cost-effective deliveries.
  • Integrated logistics support that seamlessly connects warehousing, transportation, and distribution for end-to-end supply chain efficiency.
05

Specialized Logistics For Complex Cargo.

Our specialized logistics solutions are designed for cargo that demands expertise, precision, and meticulous planning.

  • Expert management of project cargo, breakbulk, oversized, and heavy-lift shipments with detailed planning and seamless execution.
  • Specialized handling for hazardous, temperature-controlled, perishable, and sensitive cargo while maintaining strict safety and regulatory compliance.
  • End-to-end logistics planning and operational coordination, delivering customized solutions backed by experienced professionals and global logistics expertise.
